# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest release line and to the `main` branch.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest  | Yes       |
| Older   | No        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Report it privately through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/grasdouble/Lufa-Design-System/security/advisories/new).

Include reproduction steps, affected versions, impact, and any suggested mitigation. A maintainer
will acknowledge the report as soon as practical and coordinate disclosure after a fix is available.
